response.note: Assumes 'last week' is the previous Monday-Sunday week (2026-10-19 to 2026-10-25), and that status uses 'SUCCESS' and region uses 'West'; success rate is computed per merchant over payment attempts.
response.sql: SELECT merchant_id, merchant_name, COUNT(*) AS total_attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_attempts, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS success_rate_pct FROM v_attempts_clean WHERE region = 'West' AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-19' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-26' GROUP BY merchant_id, merchant_name ORDER BY total_attempts DESC LIMIT 50
